verdict.rationale: Together AI documents API, SDK, and CLI access for its main console workflows. Fine-tuning can be launched "from the console, through the API/SDK, or with the CLI", dedicated endpoints and batch jobs have CLI/API paths, and a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec plus a generated per-endpoint reference back the REST API. However, no source explicitly claims full UI-to-API parity, and account-level console functions are not evidenced as API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API coverage for account/org/billing/key management, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
